items.t: Fauvist flat colour. Unmixed saturated paint chosen for feeling rather than accuracy, visible brush, no blending, shadows in colour rather than grey.
Expressionist brush. Thick fast strokes, proportion bent for emotion, colours clashing on purpose, the ground showing between marks.
Naive folk painting. Flattened perspective, everything roughly the same size, decorative pattern in clothing and floors, no cast shadows.
Gouache animation background painting. Matte layered flats, soft edges only where paint met wet paint, slight paper bounce in the whites.
Watercolour with dip pen. Loose washes bleeding past the ink, blooms and backruns left in, white paper doing the work of light.
Cel animation flats. Uniform colour fields, one shadow tone, a clean line that varies in weight, painted background sitting behind the figures.
Ligne claire comic. Even weight ink line, flat colour, no hatching, clear silhouettes, every object drawn with equal care.
Linocut. Carved white lines out of one ink colour, gouge marks left showing, slight ink squash at the edges.
Monoprint. A ghosted second impression, uneven plate texture, soft edges where the ink thinned.
Chalk pastel on toned paper. Powdery strokes, the paper colour used as the midtone, smudged transitions, sharp accents only where it matters.
Oil pastel. Waxy heavy strokes dragged over one another, highlights scratched back through to the paper.
Wax crayon on cheap paper. Uneven pressure, waxy resist where colours cross, a child's confidence with an adult's composition.
Spray paint through stencils. Hard stencil edges, overspray haze, two or three layers slightly out of alignment.
Poster paint tempera. Opaque chalky flats, brush edges visible, colour laid in blocks.
Pop art screenprint. Benday dots, flat primaries, thick black keyline, printed out of register.
Constructivist poster. Diagonal composition, red black and cream, figures cut hard like photomontage, geometric blocks behind.
Bauhaus poster. Geometric primitives, primary colours, an asymmetrical grid, clean sans lettering if any.
Art deco travel poster. Stylised flattened figures, gradients done as stepped bands, four colours at most.
Sixties psychedelic poster. Melting organic shapes, vibrating complementary colours, dense pattern filling the ground.
Nineties zine photocopy. High contrast, degraded halftone, cut and paste edges, toner speckle in the blacks.
Saturday morning cartoon. Rubbery limbs, big simple shapes, flat colours, motion smears on anything moving.
Ink wash. Diluted black ink in tonal layers, drybrush at the edges, a single accent colour.
Digital painterly with chunky brushes. Colour blocked in planes, no smoothing, edges left unfinished on purpose.
Coloured pencil. Layered hatching, paper grain in the flats, burnished highlights, outlines in a darker pencil.
Paper cut layers. Hard edged shapes, limited colours, stacked layers with a real shadow gap between them.
Embroidery on fabric. Satin stitch fills with visible thread direction, French knots for texture, the weave of the cloth showing.
Chalkboard drawing. White and coloured chalk on a dark board, smudges, the ghost of an erased earlier drawing.
Airline safety card. Calm flat figures performing an absurd procedure with total seriousness, limited palette, numbered steps.
Stained glass. Leaded black lines, flat colour cells, light implied by colour choice rather than glow.
Mosaic. Small irregular tiles, grout lines, figures simplified to what tiles can carry.
Sticker bomb collage. Overlapping die cut shapes, thick white borders, a few peeling at the corner.
Woodblock print. Flat colour blocks, wood grain faintly through the large areas, key block line slightly off register from the colours.
Etching with aquatint. Fine scratched line, grainy tonal areas, plate mark visible around the edge.
Marker on brown kraft paper. White gel pen for highlights, the paper as the midtone, dark marker for shadow only.
Blueprint. White line on cyan ground, technical drawing conventions applied to a domestic disaster.
Rubber stamp. Repeated stamped shapes, uneven ink, overlaps and misses, one or two colours.
Felt and fabric collage. Cut felt shapes, visible fibres, stitched or glued edges.
Overhead projector transparency. Coloured marker on acetate, colours slightly translucent over one another, projected softness.
